document.name: Grand Concourse Library NYPL After School
document.shortDescription: Free Concourse library drop-in for ages 6-12 with homework help, reading support, STEAM activities, and snacks after school.
document.longDescription:
The New York Public Library's Grand Concourse branch highlights NYPL After School as a free drop-in program for kids ages 6-12. The official branch page says the program takes place after regular school hours on Mondays through Thursdays when school is in session, with homework help from tutors or Teen Reading Ambassadors, reading recommendations, fun activities, and snacks.

A current official NYPL After School event listing for Grand Concourse Library shows the program running from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM and repeating across upcoming Monday-Thursday dates. Families can simply show up; no pre-registration is required.

The branch page lists Grand Concourse Library at 155 East 173rd Street, Bronx, NY 10457, with phone 718-583-6611 and email grandconcourse@nypl.org.

Sources: https://www.nypl.org/locations/grand-concourse https://www.nypl.org/events/programs/2026/03/02/nypl-after-school-4
